name: Don’t Feed the Hungry Brainrots!
desc:
Oh no... Don't feed the brainrots! 🥲

Sneak around and steal brainrots to save them! 😎
Escape when you disturb them up and they start chasing! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many brainrots as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍
